svg.aria-label: Convolutional neural network for MNIST. A 28 by 28 image passes through five 3 by 3 convolutional layers and two pooling steps, which shrink it to 7 by 7 while the slices grow from 12 to 48. Global Average Pooling reduces this to 48 numbers, and a Dense layer gives 10 digit outputs. Total 20,638 weights.
svg.title: CNN architecture overview
svg.desc: Convolutional neural network for MNIST. A 28 by 28 image passes through five 3 by 3 convolutional layers and two pooling steps, which shrink it to 7 by 7 while the slices grow from 12 to 48. Global Average Pooling reduces this to 48 numbers, and a Dense layer gives 10 digit outputs. Total 20,638 weights.
svg.text: Blue: holds weights. Grey: no weights. BN: Batch Normalisation. Dropout: training only.
